question: For storage/atlassian-anonymous-media-upload-token, does the anonymous mediaApiUploadInformation token permit general-purpose blob storage or only per-ticket attachments, and what is the exact token lifetime across Jira Service Management deployments?
why: A fresh 2026-11-19 probe of a public portal confirmed the anonymous urn:filestore:upload:* token, but the sample decoded to a 600-second lifetime and attachment-shaped scope; the original seed DEAD-ENDS.md probe is no longer in the repository to compare.
